name: The Westin Hapuna Beach Resort
positioning: A beachfront resort on Hapuna Beach within Mauna Kea Resort on the Kohala Coast of the Island of Hawaii, with ocean-view lanai rooms, two pools and a championship golf course
best_for: Beach lovers who want snorkeling, paddle boarding and kayaking right in front of the hotel
Golfers and families who want a full Kohala Coast resort

facts.text: The resort is on Hapuna Beach within Mauna Kea Resort, on the Kohala Coast of the Island of Hawaii.
The resort is surrounded by gardens, lava fields and cultural landmarks.
Rooms have a double-entry door with wooden privacy louvers that lets ocean breezes flow through.
A Beach Activities Hut on Hapuna Beach in front of the hotel rents paddle boards, kayaks, body boards and snorkel gear.
The Hapuna Beach golf course is a championship links-style design by Arnold Palmer and Ed Seay, within easy walking distance of the resort.
Hawaiian culture experiences include chanting, lei making and hula lessons.
Part of the Ala Kahakai National Historic Trail crosses Hapuna Beach north to Kauna'oa Bay.
Hapuna means spring of life in Hawaiian, referring to the area's underground springs.
The restaurants use herbs and produce from the hotel's on-site half-acre garden.
Guests have room-signing privileges at both the resort and sister property Mauna Kea Beach Hotel.

highlights.text: All rooms and suites have ocean and sunset-facing views from a private lanai.
The resort has two pools: a freeform family pool and an adult-exclusive infinity pool.
A snorkeling area called Turtle Point offers colorful reef fish and often sea turtles.
Guests can greet the sunrise with the Aloha Ambassador on the Hapuna Beach Lawn and hear a Hawaiian oli, or chant.
Guests can join manta ray researcher James Wing for a private snorkel tour with the Mauna Kea mantas.

considerations.text: The infinity pool is adult-exclusive; families swim in the freeform family pool.
WhataHotel notes the remote Big Island location means a longer trip from the mainland US.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the beachfront setting.
